description_en: Adds members to an IP Address Manager (IPAM)
description_zh: 添加IPAM可信服务纳管成员
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam add-ipam-members --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --members MemberId=fd-ccccncASqa MemberType=Folder --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIpamMembers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPAM hosted region.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM托管地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run. The request is checked for required parameters, request format, and service limits. Members are not added to the IPAM trusted service. If the check passes, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. If the check fails, an error is returned.

false (Default): Sends a request. If the request passes the check, the members are added to the IPAM trusted service and an HTTP 2xx status code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会添加IPAM可信服务纳管成员。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并添加IPAM可信服务纳管成员
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
